title: Build the maze state space
description: You connect the maze grid, color labels, and flattened state indices.

steps.description: You store the grid and color labels in Maze. The grid uses zero for free cells and one for walls.
You assign each free cell the color label (2*i + j) % 4. Wall positions keep the initial zero in the colors array.

steps.question: Does free_states include wall positions?
steps.answer: It includes only positions where the flattened free_mask is true. The recorded maze has 28 free cells on a 5 by 7 grid.

steps.description: You see four color labels in the printed maze description. The idx and ij helpers convert between row-column coordinates and flattened indices.
You copy belief values at free positions into a fresh grid. Wall positions remain zero in the returned grid.
